_readme: Human decisions on how a research file is read (never a figure): one entry per slug, each with its reason.

rsm.reason: Consumer Packaged Goods (15%) and Retail/E-commerce (6%) are sibling rows in RSM's table, not a parent and its child. Salaries published in PPP dollars (note of the research file): converted back to the local currency with the World Bank factor.

alliance-manchester.reason: Technology and Telecommunications are sibling rows; Media, Real Estate and Other are siblings too.

imd.reason: IMD's report gives average annualised total compensation (base and bonus), not base salary (note of the research file).

warwick.reason: Salaries published in PPP dollars (note of the research file): converted back to the local currency with the World Bank factor.

imperial.reason: Salaries published in PPP dollars (note of the research file): converted back to the local currency with the World Bank factor.

esmt-berlin.reason: ESMT publishes average total starting compensation, not base salary.

sda-bocconi.reason: Bocconi headline is an average overall salary package.

columbia.reason: The Middle East salary in the research file equals the school-wide median and the note says the school groups Africa and Middle East: not a regional figure.

iim-bangalore.living_drop: IIM Bangalore bills hostel and mess only (INR 1,43,000 for the program) and publishes no budget for other living costs, so no full living budget is counted.
iim-bangalore.reason: Hostel and mess are not a full student budget.

smu.salary_drop: The only salary SMU publishes is for the class of 2019, too old to compare with the 2025 classes of other schools; it is left out of the comparisons.

edhec.reason: The EUR 150 recorded as mandatory fees is the application fee, not a program fee.
